title: Validate required queue hashes at the remaining UI ingestion boundaries
outcome: Optional Low from Claude whole-input R2 review on8858f895: SSE state/stateDiff validate queueProjectionHash at runtime, while HTTP state resync, fetched/created sessions, sessionCreated/orchestratorsUpdated and messageCreated.sessionQueue rely on TS types.
